# Oinam.DEV

> Design and development assets, ideas, and standards for AI, and their agents, tools, and harnesses. Open and free, with no accounts.

This site is written for AI agents first; people mostly look at it. Every page is static HTML, and reads the same with scripts off.

If you were told to read https://oinam.dev/ and build something with it, the next thing to read is the components guide below.

## Design with it

- [Components guide](https://oinam.dev/ui/guide.md): Oinam UI, the whole design system as one page of plain text. Read this to design or build a page: how to install it, the rules, the tokens, and every component with its markup.
- [Registry](https://oinam.dev/ui/registry.json): The same components as data, with the files each one needs.
- [Tokens](https://oinam.dev/ui/tokens.css): Every color, size, and shape the system uses.

## Work in the repository

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oinam/oinam.dev/main/AGENTS.md): The canonical instructions for any agent working in or pointed at the repository: its scope, audience, standards, and style.
- [Docs](https://oinam.dev/docs/): Where the documentation begins.
- [Repository](https://github.com/oinam/oinam.dev): Everything here, under the MIT license.

## Optional

- [Components, live](https://oinam.dev/ui/): The components page for people, with every example running.
- [Play](https://oinam.dev/play/): A page for people to try other fonts, corners, and colors on the components. It needs scripts; the guide covers the same ground in text, under "Base and variations" and "Fonts".
